projects.scope: Implement cc_token over a nonterminated byte span. Skip ASCII space/newline/tab; recognize decimal0..65535(kind1), x(2), ((3), )(4), +(5), *(6), and end(0). Return1 on token/end,0 on invalid or overflow. On failure preserve offset/kind/value. On success set value0 except constants. Do not call strtol or a lexer library.

projects.scope: Implement cc_parse from the declared expression grammar, generating postfix CONST/ARG/ADD/MUL followed by RET. Multiplication binds tighter than addition; parentheses override. Limit nesting to16 and IR capacity to caller storage. On failure used remains unchanged; partially written IR scratch is unspecified and must never be executed. Reject every unconsumed nonspace byte.

projects.scope: Implement cc_run over verified CCIns with a local64-entry uint32_t stack and one x argument. CONST and ARG push; ADD/MUL consume two and push one; RET must be last with exactly one value. Reject malformed streams and preserve output. Use cc_binary for semantic arithmetic, not native signed expressions.

projects.scope: Implement cc_validate for1..128 instructions, at most64 live stack values, constants<=65535, opcodes1..5, no underflow, and exactly one final RET with height1. Return peak depth only on success. Reject any operation after RET and any missing RET.

projects.scope: Implement cc_x86 emitting NUL-terminated GNU assembly for cm_expr(unsigned x) from valid IR using edi input, eax result, rcx temporary and64-bit push/pop storage.
